messages.subject: Best sim out of 95PPU
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to calibrate my SWAT2012 model using the approach called "Sensi_Cali_(uniform_Latin_Hypercube_Sampling)" in R-SWAT. I did 3000 iterations to calibrate 24 parameters, I calculated the objective function and now I am at the step of Optimization/Uncertainty.

When I look at the table containing the values of Lower 95PPU, Upper 95PPU and Best Simulation, there is something I don't understand : some of the values of "Best simulation" are out of the 95PPU range. How is it possible ?

If someone could help me understanding I would be grateful, there is probably something I didn't understand in the SUFI-2 algorithm..

Thank you in advance !

Best,

Mathilde Puche

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Best sim out of 95PPU
parts:
Hi, theoretically, it is possible that the best simulated values are out of the 95PPU range, for example, 
You have 100 behavioral simulations with the values on day 1 is from 1 to 100 and the values from the best simulation is 100, in this cause the best simulated values will be out of the 95PPU.
However, just share with me the RSWATproject.rds file, I will double check it again
